description: Declarative FigJam boards — sticky notes, shapes, text, sections, groups and connectors, arranged, routed and checked by the compiler from what the board contains; previewed as a picture of the board and drawn into a FigJam file by the Graffiticode FigJam plugin.

example_prompts.prompt: A sprint retrospective with Went well, To improve and Action items columns, two notes in each.
example_prompts.notes: Three `section [ sticky … {} ] id … name … layout COLUMN {}` in a page with `layout ROW`.

example_prompts.prompt: A flowchart: Fetch data, a Valid? decision, then Save or Report error, with a dashed Retry back to Fetch.
example_prompts.notes: Shapes in a `layout FLOW` page, `before` for the stage order, labelled connectors; the return edge is just a connector.

example_prompts.prompt: A kanban board with To do, Doing and Done columns.
example_prompts.notes: Sections in a ROW, each a COLUMN of stickies.

example_prompts.prompt: A workshop board with Agenda, Brainstorm and Decisions pages.
example_prompts.notes: Three `page [ … ] id … name … {}` members in the board; pages show as tabs.

example_prompts.prompt: Add a retro board to my FigJam file https://www.figma.com/board/ABC123/Retro.
example_prompts.notes: `save-to-figjam "https://www.figma.com/board/ABC123/Retro"` on its own line before the board.
